limitations: King of the Maze companion art handoff was not separately uploaded. Project layout JSON/templates are authoritative for geometry.
All six maps passed the visible socket checks. Crystal Throne flags E9 in the low-trail-score heuristic at a multi-route junction where a perpendicular side sample lands on another valid route.
Straight-run numeric centering reported no measurable bands; exact centerline masks have been independently verified from the layout JSON, and visual overlays are included.
In-game mobile readability and full v0.15.0 renderer integration have not been run.
Individual backgrounds use painterly source environments with geometry rebuilt from JSON. This is a visual draft requiring user art approval.
The project specifies Crystal Throne as 1664x2560 pixels; the PDF summary says 1664x2432. The project source of truth was followed.
